# Quality Pharmaceuticals

> Licensed, GMP-certified Ayurvedic medicine manufacturer based in Jajmau, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, established in 1967. Quality Pharmaceuticals produces a focused range of 19+ proprietary Ayurvedic syrups, tonics, tablets, capsules, oils, ointments, drops, gripe water, and churan for everyday health needs, sold to families and healthcare distributors across India.

## Company facts

- Founded: 1967
- Headquarters: H. No. 1075 (193), Adarsh Nagar, Jajmau, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208010, India
- Certification: GMP-certified manufacturing
- Manufacturing Licence: A-73/1977/2018
- GSTIN: 09AAAFQ7540F1Z9
- Product categories: Women's Wellness, Digestive Health, Baby & Family, Liver & Tonics, Cough & Allergy, Pain & Joint, Ear Care, Skin Allergy, Fever Care, Tonics & Wellness, Memory & Wellness
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Service area: India (retail customers and distribution partners)
- Contact: +91 73553 61236 / +91 99354 30450
- Note: Products are proprietary Ayurvedic formulations. Information is provided for awareness and enquiry; use as directed on the label or by a qualified healthcare professional.
